jurisdiction: Data Protection Commissioner (s. 68; not yet established per DataGuidance)
scope: Processing connected with a controller or processor established in Belize, and processing of data subjects in Belize by a foreign entity offering goods or services to people in Belize
applies_to: Data controllers and processors established in Belize, and foreign entities offering goods/services to people in Belize; small-business exemption excludes trading in personal information
key_requirements: Data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection to direct marketing); breach notification to the Commissioner (reported as 72 hours); enforcement and information notices
data_categories: Personal data (collection, keeping, use, disclosure, protection rules); children under 16 protected, consent by parent/guardian or by the child if over 13
enforcement_authority: Data Protection Commissioner (Office of the Data Protection Commissioner)
penalties_range: Summary conviction: fine of BZD 500,000 and/or 3 years' imprisonment for breach of data-protection principles; fines of 20,000 (unlawful transfer etc.), 10,000 (unlawful obtaining/disclosure), 5,000 (breach of notices)
notes: Section 97 requires a Minister's Gazette Order to commence (DataGuidance); one summary (Clym) claims in force on gazettal 2021-11-30; no commencement order or Commissioner found; effective_date not found: the enactment date is used
